# Ghilli Goli Soda

> Ghilli Goli Soda is an Indian marble (goli/banta) soft drink brand, reimagined as a premium craft soda. Tagline: "Refreshing in Every Sip" (Tamil: ஒவ்வொரு சிப்பிலும் புத்துணர்வு). Manufactured by Oasis Food & Beverages in Pudukkottai, Tamil Nadu, India.

## About

Ghilli (also spelled Gilli) Goli Soda is the traditional Indian marble-bottle soda — the codd-neck "goli" bottle you push to pop — made with real flavours and modern quality. It celebrates Indian nostalgia (village summers, tea shops, cricket lanes, festivals) while delivering a premium product across 8 flavours.

- Brand: Ghilli Goli Soda
- Tagline: Refreshing in Every Sip
- Type: Carbonated soft drink (goli soda / marble soda / banta)
- Volume: 200 ml glass bottle
- Origin: Pudukkottai, Tamil Nadu, India
- Made in India

## Flavours (8)

1. Blueberry — the bestselling original. Bold, crisp, iconic.
2. Cola — deep, dark fizz with maximum punch.
3. Green Apple — crisp green apple kick.
4. Lemon Mint (Lemon Mojito) — sharp citrus with mint, summer refreshment.
5. Orange — sunny, tropical orange burst.
6. Paneer — the classic Indian rose/paneer soda. Clear, crisp, nostalgic.
7. Pineapple — sweet, fizzy tropical pineapple.
8. Strawberry — sweet berry crowd-favourite.

## For dealers / distributors

Ghilli runs a dealer and distributor program across Tamil Nadu and beyond — exclusive territory rights, high margins, marketing support. Enquiries via the website's dealer form or the phone numbers above. Enquiries are accepted from all 38 Tamil Nadu districts and other locations (e.g. other Indian states, Dubai/UAE, abroad).
